notes.note: This PR adds an observed engine-exit path to the Claude adapter (claude-adapter.ts) and an onExit hook to claude-code-spawn.ts: an exit without a stop closes a hung SDK stream, settles open work as interrupted, and publishes runtime.error (engine-memory-exhausted for a memory kill, else claude-engine-exited) and session.exited. Re-read this document's claims citing the changed sources; none describe Claude engine death or its classification, so it remains accurate.
